items.q: Do you offer discounts for bulk orders?
items.a: Yes! 5+ thumbnails get a better rate, and 10+ get an even bigger discount.

items.q: How many revisions do I get?
items.a: Unlimited, until you love the result.
24–48 hours, depending on the number of thumbnails.

items.q: Can you redesign my old thumbnails?
items.a: Yes, at a discounted rate. A fresh thumbnail can boost the CTR of older videos.
Send me your video title, photos and ideas → I design the thumbnail → revisions → you get the final file.
